notes.title: Update 2025.2.4 – New ST44 Liveries and Fixes
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619595/cf48b37ecf913af6b9371ff9b5b89eba18903d06.png"]Changelog 2025.2.4

New Features:
New liveries for ST44 locomotives: ST44-138, ST44-199, ST44-282, ST44-854, ST44-992, ST44-1099, ST44-1103, and M62-1769 – available exclusively to sponsors for the first month

Thales container models

Ł34 wheel loader model
Fixes:
Fog shader density now correctly depends on camera height

Fixed train length and weight calculation in driver mode

Corrected switch locking order relative to derailer

Fixed required kilometers message for dispatcher mode availability

Corrected derailer setting order when open in default position

Fixed rendering of sunflower_field_12m object

Corrected translation of signal Rm3

notes.title: Update 2025.2.2 – Improvements and Fixes
notes.content:
Changelog

 Fixed simulator freezing when writing logs
 Fixed interface language not being set correctly on first launch
 Added control hints in the SU45 cab
 Fixed automatic weather download
 Fixed text color on switch lanterns
 Fixed collider size of the 220S wagon
 Fixed buttons for opening consists and scenarios folders
 Fixed option to disable automatic scenery package download
 Fixed translations of language setting labels in the settings menu
 Updated graphics of the server selection tool

notes.title: New release of Train Driver 2 - 2025.2.1 “Fiat”
notes.content:
The latest release of Train Driver 2 2025.2.1 - “Fiat” simulator is now available for download. As part of the celebration of the 10-year anniversary of the simulator, this release will be available to all users from the very beginning, regardless of their rank! 
What's New

 SP45/SU45 locomotive model in 16 paint schemes

 SP45-012
 SU45-018
 SU45-023
 SU45-034
 SU45-056
 SU45-061
 SU45-064
 SU45-066
 SU45-073
 SU45-079
 SU45-089
 SP45-090
 SU45-115
 SU45-137
 SU45-141
 SP45-142

 The new 409Va car in paint:

 409Va_PKP_Fa_01
 409Va_PMT_Fa_02
 409Va_ZIK_Fa_03

 Woodtainer container models with different paints and loads
 BUES2000 concrete container models
 BUES2000 metal container models
 Electric fence models

Changes

 Enabling shadows for conifer_strip objects
 Making the SHP button independent of the EP09 cab control
 Changing bind assignments:

 F1-F9 - binds configurable in the settings menu
 F10 - hiding the interface
 F11 - exit from the cabin
 F12 - screenshot


Fixes

 Correction of coupling connection error
 Improved dimming behavior of instrument lights in cockpit 4E
 Fixed rain bounce on catenary wires
 Correction of the hasler odometer in the cab of EP09
 Correction of wheel clatter sound range in EP09, ET22 and ST44 locomotives
 Correction of dispatcher crashing by looping script from network ownership
